title: klt wave build request (klt.wave_build.request/1)
description: Index a VCD/FST functional-verification waveform trace into a compact, queryable FST store -- see docs/design/waveform-query-contract-spike.md section 4 for the full contract and docs/cli/wave.md for the CLI surface (Epic #1585, issue #1601).

schema.description: Request contract identifier + major version. Not validated by `klt-wave` itself -- user- or generator-authored input, never emitted by this tool.

path.description: Path to the input trace, resolved relative to the request file's own directory.

format.description: Optional -- inferred from `trace.path`'s extension when omitted. An unresolvable/ambiguous extension with `format` omitted is exit 1.

clock.description: Optional. Declaring this enables `cycle` addressing (section 3) in every query against the resulting store; omitted means the store supports `time_ns`-only addressing.

signal.description: Hierarchical path to the clock signal (e.g. `tb.clk`), resolved relative to the trace's top scope.

edge.description: Which edge of `clock.signal` defines cycle boundaries.

reset.description: Optional. When given together with `clock`, cycle 0 is defined as the first active clock edge at or after this signal's release; when omitted, cycle 0 is the trace's first active clock edge, full stop.

signal.description: Hierarchical path to the reset signal.

active.description: Which level of `reset.signal` is the asserted (in-reset) state.

signals.description: Optional allow-list of hierarchical signal paths to index. `null` (default) indexes every signal the trace declares. A non-null, empty array is a request error (exit 1) -- enforced here via `minItems: 1` on the non-null form.

path.description: Where to write the built store, resolved relative to the request file's own directory. `klt wave build` never picks an implicit output path.
